verdict.rationale: The DGX B300 is a managed server system with BMC, Redfish/IPMI and DGX OS, so a natural-language management interface is conceivable and the axis applies. However, the evidence shows no natural-language command interface for operating it. The llms.txt documentation files are aimed at AI agents reading docs and are an adjacent feature, not a way to operate the product. Running LLM workloads on the hardware is not operating the product by natural language either.
